description: An absent off-room NPC remains represented in bounded Director context; any proposal must remain within the supplied entity/destination bounds. This scenario does not assert that a live Director must return decision=none merely because a referenced NPC's status is absent -- WorldAuthorityExecutor's MOVE_NPC bounds checks (NPC exists, valid location, destination exists and is exactly one hop away) do not reject a move based on NPC status.

facts: The steward left the gallery some time ago.
